g.title: j1038294605
g.text: the infestation. where'd it come from?

g.title: j2477967547
g.text: COME OUT COME OUT WHEREVER YOU AAAARE hahahaaaaaa

g.title: j3467611464
g.text: Flare, whatever's going on, please. Stop.

g.title: j1040126113
g.text: Can... we talk about our conversation yesterday?

g.title: j608160378
g.text: That's a question with a weird answer, but I'll do my best.

g.title: j1063825631
g.text: The last time we talked about this, you kinda freaked out. Are we going to be okay?

g.title: j1336865541
g.text: Because I'm getting sick of this shit.

g.title: j528121657
g.text: Whatever's wrong, I can help you.

g.title: j1454212445
g.text: I wish we knew. We've tried to find answers.

g.title: j3638558236
g.text: yeah. sorry about that. shouldn't have jumped down your throat, it's just that this is... all a lot

g.title: j1878024332
g.text: Well! Funny thing You should ask about that...

g.title: j506795037
g.text: well, pardon me while i just laugh my ass off for a moment

g.title: j2662287899
g.text: between the situation with the rippers and now...

g.title: j1609612590
g.text: Everything was just FINE with Us until YOU gave them HOPE

g.title: j2125442407
g.text: Who are you talking about when you say "we?"

g.title: j3397056875
g.text: It was going just wonderfully until YOU arrived into OUR lives

g.title: j3527184739
g.text: because You are just so sticky sweet, aren't You? We could just Eat You Right Up...

g.title: j1050556819
g.text: Um. Pretty sure we did, but maybe I'm wrong.

g.title: j2383210841
g.text: Uh... Yeah, we did. Check your chat logs.

g.title: j3699777409
g.text: titch overwhelming. i've always been... um... well, it's embarrassing, but i've always been the emotional type

g.title: j1485908606
g.text: HOPE that they might be FREE of US. Which will NEVER. EVER. HAPPEN. AND YOU KNOW IT

g.title: j96233147
g.text: Goooood... then maybe We will get along after all...

g.title: j4074344890
g.text: Ssh... not what We are here for. We have a Question.

g.title: j3005190107
g.text: Ready to just BUGGER everything up

g.title: j3082641096
g.text: i'm sorry, you mean to tell me that clown entrati was running amok through *time* shooting people up with his little warframe serums turning them into sol-knows-what

g.title: j3611586865
g.text: and i'm still grieving the loss of my friends, i suppose

g.title: j1868408230
g.text: Not every Princess in a Castle wants to be Saved from their Dragon, isn't that right, mmmm?

g.title: j1842691835
g.text: Last I checked, I was here saving people.

g.title: j2104030227
g.text: I'm sorry? What did I do?

g.title: j511106672
g.text: I get it. Not a problem.

g.title: j4037424977
g.text: Though some of Us are the Dragon, aren't we? Ahahahaaaaa

g.title: j762553414
g.text: LEARN TO STAY OUT OF OTHER PEOPLE'S BUSINESS, SUGAR

g.title: j227143903
g.text: back on topic. where'd the infestation come from?

g.title: j1195219603
g.text: Mmm. Did you know some cultures only have one word for both Demon and Dragon? Funny, that....

g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo2.

j4179208726
g.text: Well... the Orokin didn't *just* use the Infestation to make Warframes, they used it to make a bunch of other weaponry, too-

g.title: j915925878
g.text: Who are You playing in OUR story, Sugar?

g.title: j1977058567
g.text: "no, flare, darling, they didn't just commit *one* warcrime with the poorly understood disease they farmed out of gods-know-where, they did *several,* you silly goose!"

g.title: j2549225032
g.text: i am getting such a migrane from all this

g.title: j4286447444
g.text: I've already lived through one storybook. I'm not interested in another.

g.title: j2711634751
g.text: so... is it from space? earth? the future? the past? do you know *anything?*

g.title: j3762685622
g.text: We know that it was a really effective weapon against the Sentients. But unfortunately, it tends to drive whatever biological life form it takes over insane over time.

g.title: j1850509749
g.text: We know it can communicate with other infested life forms as sort of a weird hive-mind type thing, but within certain strains. It's not very well understood.

g.title: j3291345147
g.text: OoOooOoh after Our Own Heart!! Villains are So Much More Juicy, aren't They?

g.title: j4121697819
g.text: No Choice is a Choice. Haven't You Learned that Yet?! APATHY IS A VOID THAT SCREAMS YOUR NAME.

g.title: j1030704368
g.text: Without all that Prickly MORALITY to get Stuck in Our Teeth... So from One Demon to Another...

g.title: j3434123961
g.text: but VERY WELL. IIIIF YOU don't want to answer Our question, so be it... Choose Your Own Path for now...

g.title: j3416243467
g.text: We will give You fair warning... This one BELONGS TO US. They are NOT YOURS.

g.title: j2253053793
g.text: But Hero Beware... This one belongs to US. They are not YOURS!!

g.title: j1001317437
g.text: We have Our own means of digging into Your Insides and chewing the marrow from Your bones yet...

g.title: j1587885010
g.text: yeah. i'm going to go need to doodle out some lyrics about this one. talk soon

g.title: j1277720903
g.text: Kisses, Sugar.... Ta Taaaa for now.... ;)

g.text: Quiet, Villain. Be Good For Us. Just Once.

g.text: Sssh Villain... You'll Learn. Soon Enough.

g.text: Silly Little Hero... You'll learn... You'll Learn Soon Enough...

g.text: Mmmmm.... We could get used to that.
